description: This file defines a command handler class for processing hold amount requests on savings accounts within the Apache Fineract project. It implements an interface for handling commands, is annotated for dependency injection and transaction management, and delegates the hold amount operation to a service.

classes.name: HoldAmountSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A service that handles commands to hold an amount on a savings account, delegating the operation to the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService.

methods.name: HoldAmountSavingsAccountCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the hold amount command by delegating to the write platform service.
